result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but one clear content defect stands out: a discount badge reading “−0%” on the second restaurant card, which is meaningless and looks like a data/rendering bug. There is also a minor inconsistency in the styling of the favorite (heart) buttons between cards. Horizontal clipping of carousels/chips and the bottom-cut card were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card displays a promotional badge labeled “−0%”, which conveys no discount and appears to be a placeholder or unhandled zero-value case.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0 (or null), and only render it for valid positive discounts (e.g., “−20%”).

issues.description: The favorite heart icon on the first card has no circular background container, while the second card's heart sits inside a dark translucent circle, creating inconsistent affordance styling.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same circular translucent background to all favorite buttons so they remain legible and consistent regardless of the underlying image.
